s.how: Whisk 120g flour with 200ml cold lager. Dip 300g cheese curds and fry at 185C for 60 seconds until puffed. Mix 150g sour cream, 2 tbsp mayo, chopped dill and chives for ranch. Serve hot.

s.note: pickles, olives and radishes, the Midwest classic
s.how: Arrange dill pickle spears, green olives, radishes, celery and carrot sticks on a tray of ice. Mix 200g sour cream with chopped dill and salt for a dip. Serve it like a church buffet, you betcha.

m.how: Whisk 150g flour with 250ml cold lager. Dip 600g flathead fillets and fry at 180C for 4 minutes. Fry 1kg potato chips twice. Shred a quarter cabbage and toss with a little mayo and vinegar. Serve with tartare.

w.how: Toss 800g pitted cherries with 150g sugar and 3 tbsp cornflour. Line a pie dish with 2 sheets sweet shortcrust, fill and weave a lattice from 2 more. Bake at 190C for 50 minutes and serve with vanilla ice cream.

d.how: Brew 60g ground coffee with 1L water. Stir in 200ml warm milk and pour into a thermos warmed with hot water first. Pour into the lid cup and sip slowly in the cruiser.
